Name: Lapaat's Organized Greenhouse
Author: StriderVahly
Description:
As mentioned above, this is a mod I like, but it is an xnb mod. All I did was extract it and made it Content Patcher friendly. I'm uploading this here as some people might not know how to convert an xnb mod to work with Content Patcher. The mod is literally just this one [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/644]HERE[/url].

I only did this as I don't know if the author is still active or not, and may do this for some other mods later, probably. If there is any problems with this being upload, I will take it down if I'm messaged to do so.

Downloads.Description: added toggle to generic mod menu for those wanting to keep original mod format
